action_classes: llm-search-eval pull request comment publish command
extension.description: Reviews llm-search-eval commands that act outside the local machine: `comment`, which posts or updates a GitHub pull request comment with a token, and `run` with --judge or --pairwise-judge, which sends queries and product text to a relevance judge such as an OpenAI-compatible API that may bill the account. `estimate`, `validate`, `report`, `gate`, `sample`, `comment --dry-run`, `--help` and `--version` are not matched.
extension.name: llm-search-eval command protection

action_classes: llm-search-eval pull request comment publish command
permissions.description: Identifies `llm-search-eval comment FILE...`, which joins the given Markdown files and creates or updates a comment on a GitHub pull request through the GitHub REST API, using the token in $GITHUB_TOKEN (or the variable named by --token-env) and the repository and pull request from --repo/--pr or the GitHub Actions environment. A later run with the same --id edits the earlier comment in place. `--dry-run` prints the comment instead of posting it and is treated as a safe variant. Covers the installed llm-search-eval script and `uv run llm-search-eval`, `uvx llm-search-eval` and `uv tool run llm-search-eval` launches.
permissions.label: llm-search-eval pull request comment
safer_guidance: Run `llm-search-eval comment --dry-run FILE...` first to read the exact comment text.
Check that --repo and --pr name the intended pull request before posting.

permissions.description: Identifies `llm-search-eval run` with --judge or --pairwise-judge. Results that have no gold label are sent, with the query text and product fields, to the configured judge; an `openai=MODEL` judge calls an OpenAI-compatible API (default $OPENAI_BASE_URL) with an API key from the environment, which can bill the account. `llm-search-eval estimate` takes the same options and makes no judge call, so it is not matched. Known limit: the offline `mock` judge and judges loaded from a local `module:Class` are matched too, because the judge kind is part of the option value. Covers the installed llm-search-eval script and `uv run llm-search-eval`, `uvx llm-search-eval` and `uv tool run llm-search-eval` launches.
permissions.example_command: llm-search-eval run -q queries.jsonl -p products.jsonl -s bm25=runs/bm25.jsonl --judge openai=gpt-4o-mini
permissions.label: llm-search-eval run with a remote judge
safer_guidance: Run `llm-search-eval estimate` with the same options to see the judge calls, tokens and cost before a run.
Set --max-cost, --max-tokens or --max-judgments, and use --cache so repeated runs reuse earlier judgments.
